metadata.case_name: CHENG SAI KAM v. TUTTI LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

plaintiff.occupation_before: Casual decoration worker (specialised in painting); previously worked as barber

injuries.description: Laceration on dorsum of left foot with cut extensor tendon of left 4th toe
source: the diagnosis at A&E department of the hospital was laceration left foot with cut tendon.
As a result of the Accident, the plaintiff, opined Dr Wong, suffered from laceration on dorsum of his left foot with cut extensor tendon of his left 4th toe.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of muscle, fascia or tendon of long extensor muscle of toe at ankle or foot level

manifestations.description: Residual stiffness in his left 4th toe
Persistent pain in his left foot after prolonged walking
Limited ability to stand on rung-ladder and cannot climb ladder due to pain
Stiffness at metatarsophalangeal joint of left 4th toe; flexion was 2/3 of normal range
Power over 4th toe flexion was grade 3- (at hospital) and grade 4/5 (on 4 Aug 2017)
Unstable to walk on tip-toes and complained of left foot pain on tip-toe standing / single-legged standing

treatments_received: Wound exploration and repair of extensor digitorum communis tendon to the left 4th toe under local anaesthesia
Re-repair of tendon under local anaesthesia on 14 Sept 2012
Short leg cast and heel walking
Physiotherapy (9 sessions from 17 Jan 2013 to 12 Apr 2013)
Referral to occupational therapist for work assessment

losses.description: Pain, suffering & loss of amenities (PSLA) awarded $200,000
Persistent pain and limited ability to stand on rung-ladder and to climb ladders; residual stiffness in left 4th toe

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Kam Fai v李志傑經營之惠林運輸公司
Lau Yuk Sang Jimmy v Victoria Sight Ltd trading as Windsor Spa
